failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Did Kamal Haasan work with K. Balachander in any of his films?' and Hop 3 query: 'Did Kamal Haasan star in any films directed by K. Balachander, the director of "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' are essentially identical in intent, both asking whether Kamal Haasan worked with K. Balachander, despite summary_1 already confirming this with specific film examples. The queries fail to advance beyond the already-verified relationship.
